name: Lana Do
bio: Lana is a researcher at Northeastern's Khoury College of Computer Sciences. Her work on YouDescribe focuses on AI-assisted audio description, spanning system development, user studies, and evaluation methodology.
description: Photo of Lana Do, a young Asian woman with long dark brown hair, smiling at the camera. She wears a colorful striped sweater with bands of blue, olive, yellow, navy, pink, and red, with a black crossbody bag strap. The Painted Ladies — a row of pastel Victorian houses in San Francisco — are visible behind her on an overcast day.

name: Sanjay Mirani
bio: Sanjay Mirani is a Full Stack Web Developer specializing in building scalable, user-friendly web applications. With expertise in both front-end and back-end development, he focuses on creating clean, efficient, and impactful solutions. His work spans modern frameworks, APIs, and cloud technologies, with a strong interest in delivering seamless digital experiences.
description: Photo of Sanjay Mirani, a young South Asian man with short dark hair and a closely trimmed beard. He wears dark-framed glasses and a light olive-green jacket, smiling and looking slightly off-camera. The background is a rooftop scene at night with city lights blurred behind him.

name: Zhenzhen Qin
bio: Zhenzhen Qin is a Research Assistant on the YouDescribe team, focusing on web development. She led the integration of a new AI feature and works on improving the platform's security, stability, and scalability.
description: Photo of Zhenzhen Qin, a young Asian woman with long straight black hair, looking at the camera with a soft expression. She wears a light olive-green jacket. Behind her, warm string lights glow against a blurred evening market or festival background.

name: Hyunjoo Shim
bio: Hyunjoo Shim actively maintains the site to improve the user experience on the YouDescribe website. She developed the YouDescribe tutorial interactive page and contributed to videos and slide presentations for the team's research papers.
description: Photo of Hyunjoo Shim, a young Asian woman with long dark brown hair, smiling brightly at the camera. She wears a navy Pixar hoodie and stands in front of a colorful illustrated wall featuring playful artwork of fire-themed snacks and gas-station items, likely from a Pixar studio exhibit.

name: Trung Kien Nguyen
bio: Kien is part of the YouDescribe web development as well as research team. He worked on the updated editing tool on YouDescribe platform, and is focusing the research into evaluation of AD quality.
designation: ML and Full Stack Software Engineer
description: Photo of Trung Kien Nguyen, a young Asian man with short dark hair, smiling softly at the camera. He wears a light blue zip-up hoodie over a navy quarter-zip and white polo collar. He stands at the Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles, with the white art-deco dome behind him and the lights of the city skyline stretching into the distance at dusk.

name: Rodrigo Leme de Mello
bio: Rodrigo Leme de Mello, Principal Software Engineer, was the main member of the original Codesmith team that rebuilt from the ground-up YouDescribe in 2017. His career-long passion for accessibility led him to volunteer with the project after the launch, expanding YouDescribe's capabilities and keeping the code running smoothly. Thank you, Rodrigo, for your many long volunteer hours. We are grateful. Rodrigo is currently a Trainer at Amazon/AWS.
description: Photo of Rodrigo Leme de Mello. A light-skinned man with a sparse, close-cropped beard crouches on a frozen lake. He wears a grey knit beanie, black jacket, jeans, and grey sneakers.

name: Dr. Shasta Ihorn
bio: Dr. Shasta Ihorn is a professor at San Francisco State University with expertise in statistics, psychology, and education. She leads YouDescribe's user studies and analyzes data to inform improvements to the platform.
description: TODO: add image alt description for Dr. Shasta Ihorn.

name: Dr. Vassilis Athitsos
bio: Dr. Vassilis Athitsos is a professor at the University of Texas at Arlington. He contributes to the development of the AI models behind YouDescribe, with research interests in computer vision and machine learning applied to accessibility.
description: Photo of Dr. Vassilis Athitsos, a man with short dark hair and rectangular wire-framed glasses, smiling gently at the camera. He wears a dark navy checked button-up shirt and is photographed against a solid blue studio background.

name: Dr. Alexander Blum
bio: Dr. Alexander Blum is a measurement expert who contributes to YouDescribe's evaluation work, helping the team assess the quality and impact of audio descriptions.
description: Photo of Dr. Alexander Blum, a bald white man with a salt-and-pepper beard, smiling warmly at the camera. He wears a navy blazer over a white button-up shirt, photographed against a dark grey studio background.

name: Andrew Taylor Scott
bio: Andrew Taylor Scott is currently the Linux HPC Administrator at Blue River Technology. He is interested in computer vision, machine learning, and high performance computing. He has worked in tech in the San Francisco Bay Area since the late 90's and he is currently completing a Masters degree in Computer Science at San Francisco State University. He previously completed a Bachelors degree in Computer Science at San Francisco State University and an Associates degree in Computer Science at City College of San Francisco.
description: Photo of Andrew Taylor Scott, a white man with a beard and his hair is tied behiend his head. He is smiling at the camera. there are some trees in the background.

name: Gio Jung
bio: Gio holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Master's degree in Computer Science from SFSU. His research focuses on evaluating vision language models to assess how well they are good at describing images and videos.

name: Juvenal F Barajas
bio: Gio holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and completed his Master's at SFSU in 2025, where his research focuses on large-scale video captioning models. He is particularly interested in the intersection of vision and language, model scaling, and multi-modal learning.
description: Photo of Juvenal Barajas, a 25 year old man with curly brown hair. He is smiling at the camera with a grey background.

name: Vishal Sharma
bio:
As a skilled engineer, I specialize in optimizing GPU pipeline modules through algorithm optimization and parallelization techniques. My expertise in this area allows me to identify and eliminate bottlenecks that impede performance, resulting in faster and more efficient processing. 
In addition to my work on GPU pipeline modules, I am also a seasoned backend developer, having successfully migrated code from JavaScript to TypeScript. I bring a wealth of knowledge and experience to bear on backend development projects, ensuring that systems are robust, reliable, and scalable. 
Through my passion for technology and my relentless focus on achieving excellence, I am committed to delivering high-quality results that exceed expectations. Whether working independently or as part of a team, I am dedicated to using my skills and expertise to help clients and colleagues achieve their goals and succeed in their endeavors.
description: Photo of Vishal Sharma, This picture was taken at the Golden Gate Bridge. Vishal is standing on the footpath that runs along the side of the bridge and is wearing a blue t-shirt and a black hoodie.

name: Sanket Naik
bio: Sanket was the Frontend Developer for YouDescribe and received his Master's Degree in Computer Science from San Francisco State University. He was responsible for improvements to the audio clip playback algorithm and was involved in the migration to YouDescribeX.
description: Photo of Sanket Naik, This picture was taken in front of the Golden Gate Bridge. Sanket is standing in front of the Golden Gate Bridge at the end of the Baker Beach Trail. He is wearing a black hoodie

name: Manali Seth
bio: Manali Seth is working as a data engineer for the YouDescribe project. She is a graduate student pursuing Master of Science in Computer Science at San Francisco State University. She completed her Bachelor’s in Information Technology from Charotar University of Science and Technology, India. Her interests lies in software development, data analysis and machine learning. She has co-authored a data paper on “You Described, We Archived: A Rich Audio Description dataset” for Journal on Technology and Persons with Disabilities by CSUN expected to be published in May 2023.
description: Photo of Manali Seth, Manali is smiling while waiting for food in the restaurant.

name: Kishan Patel
bio: Kishan is pursuing his master's in Computer Science from San Francisco State University. He works as a mobile application developer for the YouDescribe team and is currently building the YouDescribe app for both iOS and Android using React Native.
description: Photo of Kishan Patel. This picture was taken at Fisherman's Wharf in San Francisco. In this picture, Kishan is wearing a black sweatshirt over a white shirt and is smiling at the camera.

name: Alekya Bairaboina
bio: I specialize in frontend development, focusing on React hooks to create dynamic and efficient user interfaces. By employing cutting-edge techniques like lazy loading and memoization, I optimize applications for enhanced performance. My expertise not only lies in writing code but also in comprehending the intricacies of the application, allowing me to identify potential issues and improve overall scalability. I am dedicated to crafting reliable and user-friendly applications, ensuring a seamless experience for all users. Beyond web development, I extend my skills to mobile development using React Native, delivering versatile solutions across platforms. Whether working independently or collaboratively, my commitment is to create applications that are not only functional but also valuable and enjoyable for users.
description: Photo of Alekya Bairaboina. Alekya is standing near a landscape and is wearing a blue t-shirt.

name: Caelen Wang
bio: I'm a Master's Computer Science student passionate about the intersection of machine learning and game development. In my previous project I applied pose and facial estimation to develop a webcam motion tracking feature for online multiplayer games. My work with YouDescribe involves implementing and training video captioning models that capture temporal dependencies. Through my current work in visual language modeling, I'm excited for the impact of large language models on the videogame industry.
description: Photo of Calen Wang, Calen is wearing a grey jacket and smiling at the camera on a foggy day.

name: Beste Yuksel
bio: Beste Filiz Yuksel received her PhD in Computer Science from Tufts University, Boston, working with Robert Jacob. Her research was on the next generation of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that detect and evaluate real-time brain signals using machine learning classification of functional near infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) to build adaptable user interfaces for the general population. Her work won a Best Paper Award at ACM CHI 2016. She has also worked with Mary Czerwinski at Microsoft Research, investigating user-virtual agent interactions for the next generation of intelligent personal assistants. Beste will continue to work on building intelligent, adaptive interfaces that respond to both user cognitive and affective state in conjunction in her new Human-Computer Interaction lab.
